summary: JMU’s first loss came 34-31 in overtime at App State. Wasted field position, offensive rhythm and underneath coverage lead the response before Thursday’s home game against Troy.

items.headline: JMU loses 34-31 in overtime at App State
items.tldr: The Dukes return to Bridgeforth Stadium Thursday at 7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN2. Watch whether the short turnaround produces cleaner ordinary possessions.

items.headline: Short fields go unused after the opening touchdown
items.tldr: JMU Sports News traces four consecutive three-and-outs. The offense needs an available first-down answer before another strong defensive series ends without points.

items.headline: The quarterback rotation needs a steadier offensive rhythm
items.tldr: The Breeze’s Sunday review examines how the offense lost continuity. Watch the package’s purpose and the exchange rather than assuming a change under center creates an advantage.

items.headline: Napier calls for tighter underneath coverage
items.tldr: The coach said JMU needed to affect the quarterback and make its coverage matches tighter. Watch the receiver’s release and the space before the first tackle.

items.headline: Thursday game-day parking opens at 4:30 p.m. ET
items.tldr: JMU’s campus-operations notice says vehicles may not queue on campus before lots open. Plan the arrival separately from the 7:30 p.m. kickoff.

lead.headline: Use the field position you earn.
lead.body: Get the opening run and quick throw into a workable rhythm. Keep the quarterback exchange settled, and defend the underneath route closely enough that pressure has time to finish the down.

matchup.thesis: Turn the next short field into a real drive
matchup.question: What should fans watch in the next game?
matchup.answer: Give each quarterback package a clear purpose and a clean snap. Take the first available gain before another third down asks the offense to invent a solution under pressure.

signals.title: Drive continuity
signals.detail: Watch the first-down protection and nearest receiving option. Keep a short field from becoming another predictable third-and-long.
signals.prompt: What should I watch for with drive continuity?

signals.title: Quarterback packages
signals.summary: Make the substitution serve the call
signals.detail: Keep the formation, snap and first read settled through a quarterback change. Judge the package by the space it creates rather than the novelty of the personnel.
signals.prompt: What should I watch for with quarterback packages?

signals.title: Underneath coverage
signals.detail: Carry the receiver through his break and close on the catch under control. Make a short completion earn its yards through a tackle.
signals.prompt: What should I watch for with underneath coverage?

signals.title: Scoring decisions
signals.detail: Know the down, clock and available scoring choice before the snap. Give the final play of a drive a practiced operation rather than a rushed repair.
signals.prompt: What should I watch for with scoring decisions?

nextGameNote: Watch the first drive after a defensive stop against Troy. The useful correction is an offense that can turn that opportunity into another set of downs.
